programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Schemes In Antiques
programme.desc: When an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Once In A Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei-chun longs to reunite with her estranged father, her brother conceals his separation from his wife, and their mother harbors guilt over her husbands past departure. Can this troubled family overcome secrets and reconcile?

programme.title: Mr. and Mrs. Player
programme.desc: Chinese Feng Shui master, Carson was a Natural Born Player, taking names and breaking hearts. Fate had it that he would meet his match, the hot veterinarian, Chi-Ling.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs. Inspector Bong discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: Yum, a detective agency that handles supernatural cases, investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building. They discover that the spirits are created so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs and seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU to find his lost revolver. Ho and his team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: The Narrow Road
programme.desc: A small cleaning company owner hits tough times during the pandemic. In need of an assistant, he hires a young single mother who unexpectedly helps him solve many difficulties at work.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li Qingrang, a former street thug, encountered setbacks in his attempts to find a job after being released from prison.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung’s mad fate?

programme.title: Europe Raiders
programme.desc: Mr Lin and Miss Wang are the two top bounty hunters in the business, and are searching for the destructive missile “Hand of God” to prove who is the better bounty hunter. They soon realize they are not the only ones after the missile. Will Lin and Wang put their differences aside and work together in search for the ‘Hand of God’?

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: A pair of cops go up against an international money-trafficking cartel.

programme.title: Bodyguards And Assassins
programme.desc: On 15 October 1906, Chinese revolutionary leader Sun Yat Sen returned to Hong Kong to stage another overthrow of the Qing dynasty. Businessman Lee and Chinese Daily’s Chief Chan arrange for five bodyguards to protect Mr Sun - these are all extraordinary fighters who are ready and up for fierce battles against the Qing assassination army.

programme.title: Beyond The Dream
programme.desc: Primary school teacher Lok is a recovering schizophrenic who falls in love with a young girl he first met. As he struggles to reveal his illness, Lok has a relapse and becomes delusional. Little does he know she is a mental health counsellor who has a hidden agenda. The pair develops a relationship that is beyond their wildest dreams.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: An unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away.

programme.title: Man On The Edge
programme.desc: The triad gang leader assigns Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business. However, Ah Lok turns out to be an undercover police officer who unveils a shocking political conspiracy during the investigation.

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: Ho Sau, an undercover agent, has been working with Yau, a drug lord, for years, but his job and family are in trouble.

programme.title: Acting Out Of Love
programme.desc: Wei Hung Jen is a struggling actor. Hui Hsin, the associate producer, must write a script for a love story so as to get a reference letter to study scriptwriting overseas. Later Jen falls for Hui.

programme.title: The Sunny Side Of The Street
programme.desc: Hassans father has died in a car accident. A local taxi driver, Yat, then helps him flee Hong Kong. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the shocking truth about his fathers death.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: Beer girl and part-time model Ceci has terrible cooking skills. Coming from a well-off family that owns a big culinary business, wealthy SK meets Ceci in a gourmet competition held by his familys company. Despite their different backgrounds, Ceci and SK fall for each other. However, SKs dominating mother disapproves of their relationship. To win over her future mother-in-law, Ceci must beat her rival Jade in a gourmet showdown…

programme.title: Mamas Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol.

programme.title: Tales From The Occult
programme.desc: An old school anthology consisting of three short films, Tales from the Occult is the first in a new omnibus series about the hidden horrors that lurk behind the urban landscape of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is given the ability to resist the temptation from opposite sex but it becomes a burden when he is about to marry his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong’s biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching’s wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Table For Six

Love, friendship, jealousy and complicated relationships are all on the menu for this table for six!

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.

programme.desc: A bus transporting the inmates is flipped resulting in the felons escaping.
